account.exit: Use original trail10:5% initial close stop and10% close trailing stop, no take-profit and no fixed holding deadline. Existing numeric controls are exit rules, not required outcome thresholds. Choose this simple inherited exit to isolate the admission comparison, not by its return.
account.capital: 500000 per independent account,max5 positions,20% entry budget fixed at signal close, no topups/averaging; original ranks and budget rules retained.
account.execution: Use unchanged FixedSignalAccount/execute_account. Next-session attempts, T+1 lot restrictions, bands/capacity, sell-before-buy actual cash, persistent failed sells, no backfill or buy carry. Close exits are not guaranteed fills at their trigger percentages.
account.fees: Unchanged2022-2023 dated fee policy from frozen account contract and2024-2025 LegacyFeePolicy; commission0.03%,minimum5,10bp each-side slippage and original transfer/stamp schedules. These are simulated assumptions, not actual broker charges.
account.valuation: Retain continuous equity and open holdings with stale/unresolved flags. No fabricated terminal liquidation, no omission of open loss.

readout.absolute: All18 account metrics: return,drawdown,exposure,costs,realized/open PnL,closed win/loss means and medians,expectancy,payoff/PF,loss/gain tails and profit concentration. Undefined ratios remain null.
readout.comparison: Six knownAll-minus-persistent primary rows; show nonpersistent separately. No inferential independent-sample claim from repeated stock-days or dependent trades.

readout.coverage: All6 source rows and18 policy coverage rows; full candidate count,commonTop5,Funknown/failed/passed,rank excluded,scheduled/entered/notEntered/closed/open. Unknown and zero-signal outcomes retained.
readout.attribution: Entry-date opportunity/trade splits and continuous-equity segment returns are distinct views. Do not treat them as equal or additive causal contributions.

validation.freeze: Freeze sources,inputs,protocol and all analysis code before preparing new schedules. Pass synthetic tests before preparation; independently check all schedules before any accounts. Exclusive claims, no automatic restart of nonterminal output.
validation.independent: Separate new queue/rank/mask reconstruction from saved audited full daily candidates; inherit and validate raw source34/47 proof chain. Reuse frozen independent cash/fees/fills/holding/exit/summary oracle for all18 accounts without another account execution.
validation.tests: Sort allA beforeF,unknown slot no refill,exact rank gaps,ties,duplicates/missing dates/universe mismatch rejection,all-zero/full-calendar retention,signals are copied and future suffix cannot change earlier results; source binding/chronology,policy schedule conservation and readout paired comparison/empty slices/closed-vs-open.
validation.interpretation: Coverage is not profitability. All historical results remain development evidence; neither successful tests nor favorable aggregate returns certify stable future returns.
